$schema: Downstream patches applied on top of upstream @agegr/pi-web tarball

patches.purpose: Scope Next.js outputFileTracingRoot to the pi-web package directory so Electron packaging resolves server externals correctly
patches.test: npm run build succeeds; packaged app resolves pi-coding-agent server externals
patches.removalCondition: Upstream sets outputFileTracingRoot in published next.config.ts or electron-builder handles it

patches.purpose: Add GET/PUT /api/archived-sessions route for mobile session archive management
patches.test: mobile/tests/package-parity.test.mjs; GET returns {ids:[]}; PUT persists and re-reads
patches.removalCondition: Archive management migrated into authenticated MobileBridge BFF

patches.purpose: Preserve POSIX parent-path semantics when the web service runs on Windows
patches.test: npm test covers POSIX, Windows drive, and UNC parent paths
patches.removalCondition: Upstream directory browser selects path.posix for serialized POSIX paths

patches.purpose: Run Next build with an isolated HOME/USERPROFILE so tracing does not scan unreadable Windows profile junctions
patches.test: npm run build succeeds with a real outputFileTracingRoot and compiled archived-sessions route
patches.removalCondition: Upstream build no longer reads user-home paths during output tracing on Windows

patches.purpose: Add test script entry for downstream unit tests (lib/*.test.mjs, components/*.test.mjs)
Keep downstream session copy/archive UI and safe prompt/compaction/model recovery as a fail-closed adapter patch
patches.test: npm test covers copy, prompt/model recovery; build validates UI adapter types; manual archive/copy/compaction smoke
patches.removalCondition: Upstream offers stable extension hooks for session-row actions and equivalent recovery UX

droppedPatches.action: Do not re-apply; verify upstream behavior covers click-to-open, max size, UNC paths via staged smoke test
